desc: Solari, Inc. is the company founded by Catherine Austin Fitts which publishes the Solari Report and maintains the Missing Money archive at missingmoney.solari.com, where the September 2017 Skidmore-Fitts summary report and its supporting documentation are hosted. Solari's own framing of the material - 'the $21 Trillion dollars missing from the U.S. government' - is precisely the formulation that the underlying report does not support and that makes the analysis unusable in a hostile setting. The archive itself, however, is valuable: it preserves links to Inspector General documents whose original government URLs have been retired, and it is the only consolidated index of the underlying reports. A researcher should use Solari as a document repository and go to the primary reports it links, not adopt its framing.
